product: alt-context WP plugin admin SPA — describe run GPU tier + lifecycle state
goals: UXREC-1 target contract awaiting map gate: distinguish idle/unknown service observation, known blocked configuration, active warming/running, genuine failure, retry and remount. Existing code references are anchors, not implementation claims.
An accepted run exposes observed startup progress, its actual deadline, cancel and return-to-run; historical cold-start measurements are not a current ETA guarantee.

Existing CPU drafts remain reviewable with their reported item tier. Unknown GPU/capability never promises CPU continuation; CPU fallback is conditional on a usable configured adapter, not generic API health.

Before Describe, disclose possible GPU warm-up and infrastructure charges separately from credits, with a Settings link (INT-07, NAV-11). Read failures retain saved rows and apply recovery, show a stale notice, and offer a read-only Retry (INT-10).

jobs.label: Describe selected media with AI and apply results
Describe one image from the dashboard panel
Know which tier produced a description and what it will cost/take

screens.title: Workbench › Media selection
screens.purpose: Select media and describe; UXREC-1 proposed quiet unknown consequence copy: GPU tier not reported. Description readiness is unconfirmed. No idle failure toast. Known configuration error is separate from an accepted run failure. Existing tenant-scoped operation storage resumes accepted run_id on remount without resubmission; this is source behavior, runtime acceptance pending.

zones.label: Describe selected; selection and service readiness are separate. Proposed unknown copy makes no CPU promise. Known blocked configuration names the service and Settings recovery without inventing a new readiness API or disabling otherwise legal submissions.

Accepted run only: starting/warming/running, observed deadline, Cancel and return-to-run; completed/cancelled outcome; genuine failure with cause and supported retry. CPU drafts appear only when actual results exist.

GPU observation is not description readiness: idle unknown stays quiet; starting/warming/ready/degraded do not certify completed results. Proposed neutral unknown copy is owned by gpuStatePresentation.ts.
Review & apply drafts link — Hidden until the run is terminal; terminal runs link to #/workbench?hasDraft=1&run=<id>, regardless of item tier.
Recovery contract: read-only status retry does not restart inference; remount resumes stored tenant run_id; cancellation acknowledgement ends pending state; rejected persistence remains visible.

screens.title: Media library description review › Review & apply
screens.purpose: Review, edit and explicitly approve each image draft beside saved alt text. The run query parameter previews that run; the visible version chooser selects previous descriptions. Loading = loading; no drafts = empty; unavailable history = error or degraded. No selection saves automatically. Serves job `gpu-tier-awareness`.

zones.label: Per-image draft and saved-alt distinction, with version run/time provenance. Run result tier and naming provenance remain in the existing result API; this row does not infer a tier from failure status.
Future lifecycle requirement (M03), not implemented in review: any upgrade notice requires explicit item upgrade state; GPU readiness alone never promises final descriptions.

screens.title: Dashboard › Describe with AI
screens.purpose: Single-image describe; shows adapter/model provenance. Run phases: result = default; submitting = loading. Serves job `single-describe`.

zones.label: Provenance (Adapter / Model / Source / Latency) — State vocabulary: gpu and seeded = default; cpu (provisional tier) = degraded.
Inline error (role=alert) — State vocabulary: hidden = empty; generic = error; gpu-unreachable = offline.

screens.title: Toast — GPU tier transition
screens.purpose: Preserve source suppression of dormant GPU_STATUS_UNAVAILABLE when runId is null. Genuine in-run failures and actual completion remain meaningful feedback. UXREC-1 proposed quiet unknown wording does not suppress failures or add per-poll notices.

zones.label: Toast body — State vocabulary: info and success = default; error = error.

actions.target: POST description/correct for one media item

flows.label: Bulk describe when GPU is stopped

steps.branch_label: select → readiness/cost preview; unknown is not a CPU capability claim
accepted run → observed starting/warming with actual bound and Cancel; no fixed current ETA
if actual CPU drafts arrive → review returned drafts; do not infer a CPU path from unknown GPU state
only if operator left: announce actual results ready; GPU ready alone is not result completion
Review each image draft, preview an earlier version, edit or explicitly accept; saved alt text changes only on approval

flows.label: GPU fails to come up / unreachable

steps.branch_label: startup bound expires or endpoint fails → conditional usable-CPU fallback; without one, typed retryable run failure
genuine run failure remains visible; keep any existing drafts; no dormant unavailable toast
Review reported per-item tiers without an automatic upgrade promise; apply safe drafts, opt in to overwrites, or return to full history

flows.label: Dashboard single describe on GPU tier

steps.branch_label: submit → result; z-provenance shows Adapter=gpu_qwen30b, Model
GPU stopped → z-inline-error gpu-unreachable names the state + what to do

flows.label: Source persistence regression: navigation and reload

steps.branch_label: accepted run_id persisted under tenant; leave or reload while warming
remount resumes status reads for same run_id without POST duplicate; unavailable observation stays unknown; Cancel remains available
actual returned drafts become reviewable; acceptance is explicit, never automatic

open_questions: Should the WP operator ever get an explicit 'Start GPU' / 'Stop GPU' control (HAI-04 activate–operate–override), or is warm-on-enqueue + idle reap the only lifecycle (DEMO-UX-1-GPU-01 proposes enqueue-triggered start)? Current recommendation: no manual control in the plugin; CTA discloses the cost and lifecycle is implicit.
gpu_state source of truth: lifecycle reaper writes /run/acx/gpu-state.json vs API probes ACX_GPU_ENDPOINT_URL/health. One writer only (DATA-14).
Toast when the operator IS on the progress screen: suppress (double announcement with the polite live region, A11Y-21) — confirm with a screen-reader pass.

UXREC-1: no runtime window granted. Validate starting/results and remount on exact deployment separately; API health and recognition policy do not establish description readiness. No new GPU controls in this slice.
not_doing: No confirm tab / modal before bulk describe (workbench not-doing inherited); cost disclosure lives in the CTA label + CTA hint.
No per-poll toasts; no toast for provisional→final per item.
No GPU cost meter in the plugin (billing is operator-side, OCI).
